messages:
priya: Starting a short thread to finalize Q1 Hosted API prioritization. We have three competing asks: embeddings perf, rerank beta, and a pricing/tiering experiment. Need to pick order and concrete launch criteria.
mateo: From runtime: embeddings perf (KV+prefix cache + tighter batching) is highest engineering effort but biggest cost/latency win.
jess: UX comment: embeddings + rerank should keep consistent SDK shape. If we split UX surface, we'll need clear migration docs.
chris: Data: FintechX and Searchly flagged this as sales blockers. FintechX wants p95 <=50ms for short embeddings queries on a Dedicated pilot.
ava: CS note: FintechX will pause expansion until we show improvements. Searchly could convert to paid if embedding unit price drops ~20%.
dan: Infra: us-east GPU fragmentation during peak. Options: (A) prioritize caching/batching product work; (B) short-term capacity bump which costs money.
priya: Tradeoffs recap: A is product/runtime work, B is procurement. Which is faster to ship in Q1? Mateo?
mateo: Minimal MVP for Q1: implement prefix KV cache + per-tenant cache caps and conservative batching thresholds. That should take ~6 sprint-weeks across runtime + kernel tuning. Full batching optimizer is Q2.
jess: For the MVP UX surface propose a flag: "cache_prefixes": true and optional "cache_ttl_ms". Docs and migration note. Default off for new tenants.
chris: Proposed launch criteria for embeddings slice:
- p95 reduced by >=30% on a representative trace
- effective unit GPU time per 1k embed ops down >=15%
- CI perf benchmarks + integration tests green
priya: About the pricing/tiering experiment: Finance wants a two-tier price (standard vs low-latency). Do we couple pricing with the perf launch or move pricing to Q2?
ava: Recommend waiting. If we change pricing before performance is stable, it risks churn. Better to prove perf first then introduce tiered pricing.
dan: Also, tiered pricing requires routing by tier into different node pools. That's additional infra work.
priya: Proposal: Priority 1 = embeddings perf MVP in Q1. Priority 2 = rerank beta (soft launch to a few customers). Pricing/tiering moved to Q2 after perf is stable. Agree?
mateo: Agree. Rerank beta scope: simple /v1/rerank endpoint that accepts query + candidates and returns scores/ordering. No heavy learning-to-rank or long-tail optimizations in beta.
jess: I'll design two integration patterns for rerank: server-side call and client-side scoring. Will add code samples in Figma and a short one-pager.
priya: KR alignment draft for Hosted API team:
- KR1: Reduce embeddings GPU unit cost per 1k ops by 15% (Q1)
- KR2: Achieve p95 embeddings latency <=50ms for short queries on Dedicated pilot (by end Q1)
- KR3: Launch rerank beta with 3 pilot customers and zero critical GA blockers (Q1->Q2 handoff)
- KR4: Quality regression on eval set <=1% for quantized/optimized runs
chris: Add monitoring KR: ensure we have per-tenant perf dashboards and alerting for p95 regressions.
ava: Customer comms: do not announce pricing changes until Q2. Prepare FAQ around why pricing is delayed and what pilot customers get.
release-bot: deploy-notice: canary deployed: embeddings-cache MVP rolled to us-west pool rp-24 at 1845101200.
mateo: Kicking off perf harness against canary now. Will collect canary traces and run 72h profile.
jess: Example SDK snippet for docs / one-pager:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "input": "...",
  "cache_prefixes": true
}
```
priya: Next steps: Mateo deliver canary perf report by 1845101800, Jess to produce one-pager + SDK copy by 1845102400, Ava to coordinate pilot outreach and align FintechX. I'll write the roadmap note and sync on Wed agenda.
mateo: Caveat: if canary perf is impacted by fragmentation, we may need a short capacity bump. I'll flag ASAP if that's required.
ava: I'll keep FintechX expectations soft and avoid hard dates.
priya: Thanks all. We'll lock details in the roadmap sync on Wed. :thumbsup:
